label: NETGEAR DM200 VDSL/ADSL broadband modem
description: Bridge-only VDSL/VDSL2 (up to profile 17a, 100 Mbit/s) and ADSL/ADSL2+ modem with auto-detection of the line mode, one RJ-11 DSL port and a single 10/100 Ethernet LAN port - no switch, no Wi-Fi, no NAT.
notes: Datasheet 'Physical Specifications': One (1) LAN Ethernet RJ-45 port and One (1) VDSL/ADSL RJ-11 port. VDSL2 17a tops out at 100 Mbit/s, so both the line side and the single LAN port are declared 100M; the DSL line is deliberately NOT gigabit.
